title: Exact reachability hits a representation-complexity wall
kind: Exact sofic-orbit criterion with complete censored recovery study
summary: Exact sofic orbit closure gives a representation-independent route to either finite causal witnesses or all-time permanence, and bounded controls reproduce both a known h3 witness and a finite exact Rule-5 orbit closure. But all 170 Research034 survivors censor under the frozen explicit-graph presentations; lazy union localizes the bottleneck to slice imaging, while raw nondeterministic images exceed 6 million transitions before the known h3 control can be constructed.
takeaway: Exact reachable context exists as a finite-state object at each fixed time, but explicit graph presentation can dominate the proof cost. The next frontier is symbolic sliding-block image representation, not larger windows or higher resource ceilings.

promotion.idea: Reachability and the complexity of representing reachability are distinct
